sections.content: You know *si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional from B1 Unit 7. This lesson uses it for consequences: what would happen under an imagined condition.

items.spanish: Si cambiara el plan, ocurriría algo diferente.
items.english: If the plan changed, something different would happen.
If it rained, we would not go out.

items.spanish: Si siguiera por el camino principal, llegaría a un lugar desconocido.
items.english: If she kept to the main road, she would arrive at an unknown place.

sections.content: Don't confuse this with a real condition like *Si llueve, no salimos* (B1 Unit 15), which states a routine fact. *Si lloviera, no saldríamos* presents the rain as unlikely or purely imagined.
